lines.1: School was over for the day.
lines.2: 「Mmm...! Nothing clears your head like sleep.」
lines.3: Sleepiness had hit me during sixth period, so I'd put my head down on the desk and slept for about an hour.
lines.4: 「A message from Crab? Meet at Oasis...」
lines.5: Probably a tasting for some new curry.
lines.6: Subaru and Fukahire would probably show up later too.
lines.7: Just as I was about to pass through the school gate--
lines.10: 「The back of your shirt is hanging out.」
lines.13: Konoe briskly straightened out my messy uniform.
lines.16: Uh-oh. She was about to combo that straight into a lecture.
lines.17: 「And yet you still worry about a guy like me.」
lines.18: 「You're a good person. (looking her in the eyes)」
lines.19: 「I-I'm not doing it for YOU! If you wear our uniform that sloppily, students from other schools will laugh at us. That's all!」
lines.20: This was the difference between her and Otome!
lines.21: Apparently a straightforward compliment made her weak.
lines.22: I'd use this to deal with her from now on.
lines.24: 「Oh, there you two are. Heading home?」
lines.26: 「What's with that reaction? How rude to a maiden.」
lines.30: 「I pressed a pressure point. You won't be able to speak for about a minute.」
lines.31: 「Did Leo do something? Konoe, tell me everything.」
lines.33: 「Honestly, Leo... It's bad enough making ME look after you. What are you doing making Konoe do it too?」
lines.34: 「I've given you this kind of lecture before, you know.」
lines.35: Crap. I was trapped between the lecture duo again.
lines.36: Time to escape with courage and wisdom!
lines.37: 「Oh, I've got an appointment coming up. Excuse me.」
lines.38: 「Hm. Do you? If you have plans, then it can't be helped.」
lines.39: Heh heh. My Intelligence stat's gotta be around 96.
lines.41: 「W-whatever could you mean? It's absolutely true.」
lines.43: 「Fukahire's waiting for me at the arcade.」
lines.44: 「Haaah... Maybe I've secretly got a fiancee somewhere...」
lines.46: 「? If Samehyou is supposed to be at the arcade, why is he standing right here? How strange!」
lines.50: 「Konoe... you really care about me that much? (looking into her eyes)」
lines.53: 「No. I AM saying it for Leo's sake.」
lines.54: 「Otome, you care that much about me? (looking into her eyes)」
lines.55: 「It's part of my duty as your big sister. (looking right back)」
lines.56: Gah. This trick didn't work on Otome.
lines.57: 「And I'm warning you as a fellow student at the same school.」
lines.58: I was trapped between them again.
lines.60: They were covering each other's every opening!
lines.64: Unable to escape no matter how hard he tried--eventually, Leo stopped thinking.
lines.65: 「Hm... Konoe again. She's with Tsushima. (Though Tsushima seems to be hanging his head.)」
lines.67: 「'In my opinion, what with the folk dance and all, those two seem pretty suspicious. I'd like to hear the details from Nao-chan sometime'... is that it?」
lines.68: 「Fair enough. There's supposed to be a good new ramen stall by the station. Why don't we invite Konoe and go together?」
